pages.title: Reinforced
pages.text: The base of the tandem. Mutates from Forestry's own Valiant and Noble bees. Sturdy, common, and the gateway to everything above it.

pages.title: Witheria
pages.text: A side branch, not a child of Reinforced. Mutates from Forestry's Industrious plus a Mutated bee. Carries the Withering aura, which applies Wither to nearby hostiles.

pages.title: Draconic
pages.text: Mutates from Witheria and Reinforced together - both parents required, same as the frame recipe below. Carries the Draconic aura: damages nearby hostiles and grants Strength to players.

pages.title: Legendary
pages.text: The top of the tandem. Mutates from Witheria and Draconic together. Carries the Legendary aura: Regeneration and Absorption for nearby players. Everything about this tier - the frame, the tools - is the most expensive version of its kind.

pages.title: Mutated
pages.text: A separate line entirely, mutating from Forestry's Majestic bee plus Reinforced. Carries the Mutagenic aura, which hands out a random buff to nearby players each pulse.
